title: IPL-2 FEMA Case; Most Penalties Against BCCI, Lalit Modi & SBI Set Aside
description: SAFEMA Tribunal set aside most FEMA penalties in the IPL-2 remittance case, while sustaining a limited penalty for one specific remittance.The post IPL-2 FEMA Case; Most Penalties Against BCCI, Lalit Modi & SBI Set Aside appeared first on TaxGuru.
